Rina T: Heads-up 1: we need a light SI "quickstart" for marketplace + HW partner integration. Pilot goal: 1-day fast-track for experienced SIs.
Omar H: 1-day sounds great for proof-of-concept teams. Must be low-friction: pre-provisioned cloud creds + loaner hardware ready.
Becca J: Suggestion: split into morning self-study (2 hrs) + afternoon hands-on lab (4 hrs) + 1-hr Q&A. Short exam after Q&A.
Carlos M: Lab topology: minimal VPC, Redwood Dedicated small pool, sample model, and a simple fallback route. I can script infra with terraform snippet.
Carlos M: ```
module "redwood_demo" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/demo-terraform"
  region = "us-west-2"
}
```
Becca J: Nice. Need deterministic smoke test so grading is fair. Ops can auto-collect logs.
Omar H: Hardware partner can preload images and put serials in CSV for staging. That avoids install time.
Rina T: Legal: any concerns about loaner liability and data capture during exam?
LegalBot: Short addendum required: loaner liability + ephemeral log retention (7 days). Will draft template.
ops-bot: Created task P-4999: quickstart kit + pilot plan. Assignees Omar H, Becca J. Due 2025-02-28.
Rina T: Next steps: Omar produce kit BOM and shipping options, Becca craft 1-day agenda + exam, Carlos prepare terraform and smoke-test script. Target pilot: 2025-03-18.
Omar H: Acknowledged. I'll confirm loaner availability by EOD Tue.
Becca J: I'll circulate agenda tomorrow in #partnerships. Keep thread for updates only. :rocket:
